outcome: Help audiences discover relevant, eligible content while preserving choice, consent, diversity, age suitability and editorial policy.
overview: Regional streamers and publishers carry deep Arabic and international libraries, yet generic rails and search leave much of the catalogue undiscovered, while opaque ranking risks narrowing exposure or surfacing age-inappropriate titles. This solution combines consent-aware audience profiles with catalogue, rights and age metadata, applies editorial and diversity policy before ranking, and explains every recommendation. Controlled experiments with holdout groups measure discovery, completion and retention honestly rather than by engagement alone. A 6–10 week proof of value on one surface targets measurable discovery and retention gains while meeting agreed diversity, age-suitability and consent thresholds, with editorial oversight preserved.

benefits.text: Lift catalogue discovery and completion through consent-aware, explainable recommendations
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Validated only through controlled experiments with holdout groups on the customer’s own audience — not a guarantee

benefits.text: Protect editorial policy, diversity of exposure and age suitability with hard eligibility gates ahead of ranking
benefits.source: Architecture design — policy, age and diversity gates run before the ranking layer
benefits.limits: Gate quality depends on catalogue metadata and age-classification coverage

benefits.text: Improve retention of Arabic-first regional audiences underserved by generic rails
benefits.source: Redington Media catalogue; regional streaming growth context
benefits.limits: Basis: hypothesis. Depends on Arabic catalogue depth and metadata quality; measured only against holdout cohorts

residency: Deployable in-country on local AWS or Azure regions (e.g. UAE, KSA); audience profiles, consent records and viewing events remain in the customer tenancy in the reference designs

notFor.situation: No content taxonomy or age and rights metadata on the catalogue
notFor.why: Eligibility gating and diversity measures depend on catalogue metadata; ranking without it optimises engagement blindly

notFor.situation: No consent framework or lawful basis for behavioural personalisation
notFor.why: Profiles are built only from consented signals; without consent the system can serve only generic editorial rails

notFor.situation: No product capability to run controlled experiments
notFor.why: Discovery and retention claims are validated only through holdouts; without experiments benefits cannot be honestly measured

Delivery pod: Partner delivery lead + project manager, ML engineer, data engineer; customer product owner, editorial policy lead, privacy and child-safety reviewer, security approver · Support model: Business-hours or 24×7 option; severity-based response targets; partner service desk with vendor escalation

3) Ranking and policy-gate build

5) Controlled launch on the pilot surface
6) Stabilisation and handover
